data.name: frutiger aero
data.detailed_description:
🌈 Step Into the World of Frutiger Aero

Welcome to Frutigo Aero, a cozy puzzle adventure inspired by the Frutiger Aero aesthetic and the retro-futuristic optimism of the early 2000s.

This world is filled with glowing glass, soft gradients, floating UI, and that clean, hopeful feeling of early digital design. You’ll explore surreal, dreamlike spaces built around curiosity, calm exploration, and simple joy. Whether you’re playing solo or with a friend, it’s a place to slow down and exist inside a future that once felt inevitable.

-A Journey Through Frutiger Aero Nostalgia

- Solve Puzzles & Discover Secrets
Interact with the environment, uncover hidden details, and unlock cosmetic rewards as you move through a series of Frutiger Aero-inspired zones, each designed to feel playful, warm, and slightly unreal.

■ 2-Player Cozy Multiplayer
Team up with a friend locally or online to solve puzzles together, explore new areas, or just sit and enjoy the music.

■ Customize Your Frutiger Self
Dress up in aesthetic outfits, unlock accessories, and make your bubbly character truly your own.

■ Chill with Cute NPCs
Talk to odd little creatures, each with their own charm and quirks, as you uncover new corners of the Aero world.

■ A Soundtrack You’ll Wish You Could Hug
Let the original Frutiger Aero music guide you from glossy synths to calming ambiance, it’s designed to make you feel at peace.

■ A Softly Connected World

Explore small but beautifully crafted zones, each with its own vibe and atmosphere. There’s no rush. Just let the game gently lead you toward its many cozy surprises.

data.short_description: Welcome to Frutiger Aero, a cozy 2-player puzzle adventure set in the nostalgic future we were promised but never got. Explore dreamy zones of bubbly glass, glowing gradients, and soft retro UI. Solve puzzles, unlock cosmetics, and vibe solo or with a friend in a world made to ease your mind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
